name: @sand/agents
description: Sub-agents and background jobs: the agent tool, agent definitions and job tracking

sand.label: Agents
sand.summary: Sub-agents the agent can start, in the foreground or as background jobs

uses.llm: agent definitions cannot set an effort level
uses.instructions: sub-agents get no environment or project instructions in their prompt
uses.modelSettings: sub-agents get no model name in their prompt
uses.ui: background results that cannot be delivered fail silently
uses.transcript: agent calls use the generic tool view
uses.steering: background results start a new turn instead of joining the running one
